periods.label: FY2025
periods.source_note: No separate depreciation & amortisation line is disclosed; investing cash outflow of only €3,451 in FY2025 indicates a negligible depreciable fixed-asset base. EBITDA is therefore approximated as Operating Profit in downstream metrics — flagged as an explicit assumption, not a disclosed figure. Creditors due >1yr increased €83,655 following drawdown of a new bank loan; creditors due <1yr increased €153,768 (trade creditors €26,768→€55,246 plus Directors' loans in-period, which were fully repaid by October 2025).

periods.label: FY2024
periods.source_note: Customer channel breakdown (Enterprise/Independent/R&D) and total customer count are only disclosed for FY2025 in the source document, not FY2024. FY2024 admin expenses (€1,560,853) is derived: source states FY2025 admin expenses of €1,286,058 represents an €274,795 (18%) decrease vs FY2024, so FY2024 = €1,286,058 + €274,795. FY2024 revenue_pct_ireland of ~95% is derived from the disclosed 'less than 5% of revenue from outside Ireland' in FY2024, so treat as an approximate lower-bound complement, not an exact disclosed figure.

kpi_targets.target: CAGR of no less than 50% p.a.
kpi_targets.description: Primary KPI under the Senus 2030 strategy: grow revenue at a compound annual growth rate of no less than 50% through the period FY2026–FY2030.
Grow the Enterprise customer base from 36 accounts in FY2025 to more than 100 by FY2030.
Grow average Annual Contract Value across Enterprise customers to more than €50,000, from a FY2025 range of €12,309 (SOIL) to €58,900 (ERA).

kpi_targets.target: Less than 50% of revenue from Ireland
kpi_targets.description: Reduce reliance on the Irish market to less than 50% of group revenue as the UK and mainland Europe scale.
Company targets becoming EBITDA positive during the financial year ending 30 June 2028.

corporate_facts.value: €100,000 SBCI-backed term loan drawn in FY2025
